name: ROTCE
definition: Return on tangible common equity as presented by management for the quarter, with the significant items noted in the presentation excluded.

name: Standardized CET1 ratio
definition: The firm's standardized Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio at the quarter end, as reported by the CFO.

name: NII ex. Markets outlook
definition: Management's full-year 2026 outlook for net interest income excluding Markets, revised up during this call from $95 billion.

name: Adjusted expense outlook
definition: Management's new full-year 2026 adjusted expense outlook, $2.5 billion above the prior guide.

name: Card net charge-off rate outlook
definition: Management's full-year 2026 outlook for the Card net charge-off rate, lowered to reflect better-than-expected consumer credit performance.

name: AWM long-term net inflows
definition: Net inflows into long-term Asset & Wealth Management products in the quarter, as reported by the CFO.

name: Assets under management
definition: Asset & Wealth Management assets under management at the quarter end, as reported by the CFO.

name: Capital deployment target return
definition: The return at which the CEO said the firm aims to deploy its capital over time.
